name: Original US-styled duplex outlet with satin bronze faceplate

placement.origin: Center of faceplate at finished wall plane Y=0
placement.allowed_rotation: Rotate 90 degrees about local Y for horizontal faceplate; preserves front and cavity axis
placement.mounting: Recessed wall box; remove host finish and backing from required conceptual cavity

interfaces.host_requirement: Do not place into an uncut solid backsplash or cabinet. The opening and service depth rotate with the collection. Keep clear of framing, plumbing and concealed equipment.

operating_envelope.geometry: True blade and ground apertures, front plate openings and hollow rear box
operating_envelope.plug_clearance: Provide accessible space in front for selected plug body and cord bend; no plug or cable modeled

limitations: Original visual power-location concept only: no voltage/current rating, wiring design, electrical listing, GFCI protection or code approval
Connection, wet-location protection, circuiting, box fill, mounting spacing and clearances are unselected
Host cavity and accessible plug/cord space require review

source.basis: User-requested nominal 2.75 by 4.5 inch plate. All other geometry original conceptual assumptions; not copied from manufacturer CAD.
